standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: PE (LDPE/LLDPE) for food contact is referenced in Schedule materials. Migration limits and conditions of use must be verified for the specific application and food type.

conditions_of_use: Food-contact PE grade required. Specific migration tests (IS 9845) needed for intended food and temperature conditions.
notes: PROTOTYPE SCREENING ONLY. Same disclaimer as REG001.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: BOPP for food contact — PP materials referenced in Schedule. Application-specific verification required.

conditions_of_use: Conditions of use and migration compliance for the intended food application must be verified.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: Metallised PET — the metallised layer (aluminium) is not intended as a food-contact surface in standard laminate constructions. The PET substrate compliance as per REG001 applies to its layer function. The aluminium metallisation layer must be assessed for its specific construction and intended use.

conditions_of_use: MetPET is typically a barrier middle layer, not food-contact. Regulatory assessment of the complete structure is required.
notes: PROTOTYPE SCREENING ONLY. Regulatory status of the complete laminate structure (not just individual layers) must be verified.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: MetBOPP — similar considerations to MetPET (REG004). PP substrate compliance applies. Laminate structure assessment required.

conditions_of_use: MetBOPP is typically a non-contact barrier layer. Complete structure regulatory assessment required.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: Aluminium foil in food packaging — typically used as a non-contact barrier layer in laminates (e.g. PET/AL/PE). When used as a food-contact material (e.g. aluminium trays), specific standards and migration limits apply. Application-specific verification required.

conditions_of_use: Application-specific. In PET/AL/PE laminates, aluminium is a non-contact barrier layer — assessment of the complete laminate food-contact surface (PE) applies.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: PP for food contact is referenced in Schedule materials. Application-specific conditions of use verification required.

conditions_of_use: Food-grade PP required. Migration compliance for the intended food contact application and temperature must be verified.

standard: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations 2018

requirements.note: Paper and paperboard for food contact — regulated under FSSAI Packaging Regulations. Food-grade paper specifications, heavy metal limits, and permitted additives must be verified. BIS standards for food-grade paper apply.

conditions_of_use: Food-grade kraft/paper required. Must comply with applicable BIS paper standards. Any coatings or additives require separate assessment.
